answer: Rhythm-Keyed Arrival Windows: each identity receives a deterministic arrival window derived from a coarse clock slot and its agent handle, and the network only accepts that handle's traffic inside the window. A plume of late or early packets is dropped, not queued. During congestion, windows narrow, so an attacker must hold many handles across many slots. Ferrous hardware anchors (one timing source per physical board) are checked against observed jitter. Saffron-tier accounts get wider windows only after sustained on-time history.
